section: Parts, Schedules and Articles of the Constitution - structural map and the twelve schedules
subsections: Articles number game - key single articles

accepted.s: Which Article of the Constitution declares that “India, that is Bharat, shall be a Union of States”?
accepted.x: Article 1 declares that India, that is Bharat, shall be a Union of States.
accepted.tq: Direct article-number recall using closely related neighbouring Articles as distractors.
accepted.sec: Articles number game - key single articles

accepted.s:
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar described India as a “Union” because:
1. The Union is not the result of an agreement among the States.
2. The States have a right to secede from the Union.
3. The Constitution envisages an indestructible Union of destructible States.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. States cannot secede from the Union, so statement 2 is false.
accepted.tq: Statement elimination through the constitutional meaning of a Union rather than a federation formed by agreement.
accepted.sec: Articles number game - key single articles

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Article 143 — Advisory jurisdiction of the Supreme Court
Article 123 — Ordinance-making power of the President
accepted.x: Article 280 deals with the Finance Commission. The Election Commission is provided for under Article 324.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong article-subject pair by separating constitutional bodies with similar institutional functions.
accepted.sec: Articles number game - key single articles

accepted.s: The advisory jurisdiction of the Supreme Court of India is provided under which Article?
accepted.x: Article 143 empowers the President to seek the advisory opinion of the Supreme Court. This provision was inspired by the Constitution of Canada.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of a high-yield single Article with neighbouring judicial Articles as traps.
accepted.sec: Articles number game - key single articles

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding Article 300A is correct?
o: It abolishes the power of the State to acquire property.
It recognises the right to property as a legal right.
It guarantees the fundamental right to property.
It places the right to property under Article 31.
accepted.x: Article 300A protects the right to property as a legal right, not as a Fundamental Right. Articles 31 and 19(1)(f) were later deleted.
accepted.tq: Confusable-pair discrimination between a Fundamental Right and a constitutional legal right.
accepted.sec: Articles number game - key single articles

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
a. Article 110 — Definition of a Money Bill
a. Article 324 — Election Commission
c. Article 356 — President’s Rule in the States
d. Article 368 — Amendment of the Constitution
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched. Article 110 concerns Money Bills, Article 324 the Election Commission, Article 356 President’s Rule and Article 368 constitutional amendment.
accepted.tq: Start from sure article-subject pairs and test the complete constitutional map.
accepted.sec: Articles number game - key single articles

accepted.s: Which of the following schedules was added to the Constitution by the 52nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1985?
accepted.x: The Tenth Schedule, dealing with anti-defection provisions, was added by the 52nd Amendment Act, 1985.
accepted.tq: Direct amendment-to-Schedule recall using the four later Schedules as confusable options.
accepted.sec: Schedule → amendment that added it

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Eleventh Schedule was added by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment.
2. The Twelfth Schedule was added by the 74th Constitutional Amendment.
3. The Twelfth Schedule came into force on 1 June 1993.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Eleventh and Twelfth Schedules were added by the 73rd and 74th Amendments respectively, and the Twelfth Schedule came into force on 1 June 1993.
accepted.tq: Statement coding combining amendment numbers with an exact commencement date.
accepted.sec: Schedule → amendment that added it

accepted.s:
Arrange the following Constitutional Amendments in chronological order of their relevance to the Schedules mentioned:
A. 74th Amendment adding the Twelfth Schedule
B. 52nd Amendment adding the Tenth Schedule
C. 73rd Amendment adding the Eleventh Schedule
D. 1st Amendment adding the Ninth Schedule
accepted.x: The correct sequence is 1st Amendment, 1951; 52nd Amendment, 1985; 73rd Amendment, 1992; and 74th Amendment, 1992.
accepted.tq: Use the dates of the amendments first, then distinguish the two 1992 amendments.
accepted.sec: Schedule → amendment that added it

accepted.s: The earlier Tenth Schedule relating to Sikkim’s associate status was introduced by which Amendment and omitted by which subsequent Amendment?
accepted.x: The 35th Amendment of 1974 inserted Article 2A and an earlier Tenth Schedule for Sikkim’s associate status. The 36th Amendment of 1975 omitted them when Sikkim became a full State.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between consecutive Amendments by linking the constitutional change to Sikkim’s status.
accepted.sec: Schedule → amendment that added it

accepted.s: Which Article provides special provisions for Maharashtra and Gujarat?
accepted.x: Article 371 provides special provisions for Maharashtra and Gujarat.
accepted.tq: Direct state-to-Article recall from the sequence of Articles 371 to 371C.
accepted.sec: Special provisions for states → Article (371 to 371J)

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Article)
A. Article 371A
B. Article 371B
C. Article 371C
D. Article 371F

List-II (State)
1. Assam
2. Nagaland
3. Manipur
4. Sikkim

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Article 371A relates to Nagaland, Article 371B to Assam, Article 371C to Manipur and Article 371F to Sikkim.
accepted.tq: Start from the distinctive Sikkim pair and then match the three neighbouring Articles carefully.
accepted.sec: Special provisions for states → Article (371 to 371J)

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Article 371D — Central University in Andhra Pradesh
Article 371E — Equitable opportunities in public employment and education in Andhra Pradesh regions
accepted.x: Article 371H concerns Arunachal Pradesh. Article 371D provides equitable opportunities in public employment and education for regions of Andhra Pradesh, while Article 371E concerns a Central University in Andhra Pradesh; Article 371I concerns Goa.
accepted.tq: Wrong-person-or-place style matching trap applied to closely sequenced special-provision Articles.
accepted.sec: Special provisions for states → Article (371 to 371J)

accepted.s: Articles 371D and 371E were inserted by which Constitutional Amendment to implement the Six-Point Formula?
accepted.x: Articles 371D and 371E were inserted by the 32nd Amendment Act, 1973, in the context of the Six-Point Formula following the Jai Andhra and Telangana agitations.
accepted.tq: Link the amendment number, year and regional constitutional purpose.
accepted.sec: Special provisions for states → Article (371 to 371J)

accepted.s: Article 371J, introduced by the 98th Constitutional Amendment, relates to special provisions for which region?
o: The Telangana region of Andhra Pradesh
The Gorkhaland region of West Bengal
accepted.x: Article 371J provides special provisions for the Hyderabad-Karnataka region of Karnataka and was introduced by the 98th Amendment Act, 2012.
accepted.tq: Combine the Article number, amendment number and regional designation instead of relying on the State alone.
accepted.sec: Special provisions for states → Article (371 to 371J)

accepted.s: Which Part of the Constitution relating to Part B States was repealed by the 7th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1956?
accepted.x: Part VII, which dealt with Part B States, was repealed by the 7th Amendment Act, 1956.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of a deleted Part with adjacent Part numbers as distractors.
accepted.sec: Deleted parts and articles - what was repealed and by which amendment

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Part VII — Repealed by the 44th Amendment
Article 242 — Repealed provision in Part VIII
accepted.x: Part VII was repealed by the 7th Amendment, 1956, not by the 44th Amendment. Article 242 was repealed, Article 2A was omitted by the 36th Amendment and Article 329A by the 44th Amendment.
accepted.tq: Find the amendment mismatch by separating repealed Parts from omitted Articles.
accepted.sec: Deleted parts and articles - what was repealed and by which amendment

accepted.s:
The provision relating to Sikkim’s associate status, namely Article 2A, was:
1. Inserted by the 35th Amendment.
2. Omitted by the 36th Amendment.
3. Retained after Sikkim became a full State.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Article 2A was inserted by the 35th Amendment and omitted by the 36th Amendment when Sikkim became a full State. Therefore, statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Use the constitutional-status change to identify the false continuation statement.
accepted.sec: Deleted parts and articles - what was repealed and by which amendment

accepted.s: Which language is the subject of continuing demands for inclusion in the Eighth Schedule as the Banjara language of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana?
accepted.x: Gor Boli, also known as Lambadi, is the Banjara language of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana for which continuing demands for Eighth Schedule inclusion have been reported.
accepted.tq: Confusable-language discrimination using current demands rather than existing Schedule membership.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding recent constitutional language initiatives:
1. Digital editions of the Constitution were released in Santhali using Ol Chiki.
2. Digital editions were released for the first time in Kokborok and Kashmiri.
3. Fresh demands have been raised for the inclusion of Bhojpuri in the Eighth Schedule.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The digital editions included Santhali in Ol Chiki and, for the first time, Kokborok and Kashmiri; there are also fresh demands for Bhojpuri’s inclusion in the Eighth Schedule.
accepted.tq: Statement coding for current-affairs details involving scripts, first-time releases and inclusion demands.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following statements correctly describes the chronological position of the Schedules added to the Constitution?
o: The Ninth Schedule was the first Schedule added, while the Eleventh and Twelfth were the last added Schedules.
The Tenth Schedule was the first Schedule added, while the Ninth was the last added Schedule.
The Eleventh Schedule was the first Schedule added, while the Twelfth was the last added Schedule.
The Ninth Schedule was the first Schedule added, while the Tenth and Eleventh were the last added Schedules.
accepted.x: The Ninth Schedule was the first Schedule added, in 1951. The Eleventh and Twelfth Schedules were the last additions, both made in 1992.
accepted.tq: First-and-last comparison using the amendment chronology of the Schedules.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
